title: Time Gal & Ninja Hayate
native_title: タイムギャル＆忍者ハヤテ
overview:
Reika's love and Hayate's courage have become one!

The LD games that were huge arcade hits, "Time Gal" and "Ninja Hayate", perfectly revived!

This two-disc set brings together two animated interactive movie games. Watch the scenes play out and react the instant danger appears: press the right direction to dodge or the button to strike, or watch your hero meet a sudden end and lose a life.

In Time Gal, the heroine Reika leaps through time across 16 eras, from the age of dinosaurs to the far future, in pursuit of the villain Luda. At Time Stop moments you have seven seconds to pick the right one of three choices. In Ninja Hayate, the ninja Hayate fights his way into a castle to rescue a princess, using his sword and grappling hook to get past each new threat.

- Two games, one per disc
- Selectable difficulty levels, with on-screen prompts on easier settings
- One or two players taking turns

レイカの愛とハヤテの勇気がひとつになった！
アーケードで大ヒットしたLDゲーム「タイムギャル」と「忍者ハヤテ」を完全復刻！
